name: HARPREET SINGH
player_statement:
A complete player, HARPREET SINGH has made a big mark in cricket. With 156 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 148, with an average of 21.58 and a quick strike rate of 138.64. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 213 sixes and 273 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 504.0 overs, taking 206 wickets at an economy rate of 6.40. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
